Smoking up today after a 9 month "break"
I finally managed to score some weed today after an involuntary 9 month break. Lost my contact and then I moved to a new city so I haven't really been able to get my hands on any. Well, that changed today. I'm so excited, almost as if it were my first time!

We're drifting apart.
I feel like I'm about to lose my best (and only friend). We met online 3 years ago and have been friends ever since. We used to talk to each other on a daily basis but for the last couple of months we barely talk once a week. We're running out of things to talk about, and I'm pretty sure she's starting to get bored of me. I've talked to her about this a few times and she said we're gonna be friends for life, but I don't think that's true. She's got plenty of friends in real life, has a lot of hobbies, and is always out being productive. I on the other hand, have no social life. I'm not even remotely interesting. It's a miracle we've managed to stay friends this long. Most people get bored of me real quick. It's only a matter of time before she moves on and forgets about me and I'm really scared.. she's been such a great friend and she's always helped me feel better about myself and I don't want to lose her. What should I do?
